# Day 2 preparation

CRITICAL VISUAL RULE: communicate the roadmap only through people, branch paths, checkpoints, and color. Every planning surface, laptop, wall, and object must be blank. Do not draw the GitHub logo, Octocat/Invertocat silhouette, wordmark, letters, numbers, code, charts, interface controls, badges, captions, or labeled icons.

Create premium animated 16:9 GitHub key art, composed safely inside a 3:2 generation canvas. Render a cinematic 2.5D animated-film still with an expressive, diverse software team, GitHub dark-mode depth, contribution-grid texture, repository roadmap paths, crisp Octicon-inspired geometry, sophisticated lighting, and optimistic forward motion. Use approximately 80% near-black or off-white, 10% neutral gray, 5% GitHub green, and 5% Copilot purple.

Show the team physically arranging one concise repository-style roadmap: a narrow starting branch, one chosen strategy path, a success checkpoint, a fallback branch, a governance gate, and a final demo merge. Differentiate each stage only through shape, spacing, and restrained color rather than labels. The visual POV is focused ambition: define success, limits, evidence, and recovery before the clock starts.

Place the roadmap and team on the left and reserve the right 38% for slide copy. No logos, mascots, generic planning board, words, letters, fake UI, screenshots, interface panels, or watermarks.
